'''Vigro's Repulsorlifts''' was a [[Landspeeder/Legends|landspeeder]] repair shop located in the [[City/Legends|city]] [[Zarra/Legends|Zarra]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Cato Neimoidia/Legends|Cato Neimoidia]], which was operated by the [[Neimoidian/Legends|Neimoidian]] [[Vigro]] during the early [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].
